_comment: Copy to price_sheet.json and fill in the per-million-token rates you are actually billed at, read from Anthropic's pricing page at the time you refresh. Rates are deliberately NOT committed with real values: a checked-in price is a world-state claim that silently goes stale (#3744). Without price_sheet.json the churn view reports tokens only and omits dollars entirely. `default` is used for any model with no explicit entry; keys are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
